issues.title: Transport Minister Reviews Plans to Upgrade Jordan’s Transport System
issues.title_en: Transport Minister Reviews Plans to Upgrade Jordan’s Transport System
issues.summary: Minister of Transport Nidal Qatamin met with Yahya Al-Kasbi, chairman of the Public Services Committee at the Senate, and committee members to review the ministry’s plans and projects to develop Jordan’s transport system across its various modes and sectors.
